description:
## Objective

Port the core Flow authoring parity scenarios and shared fixtures.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-04-1255-test-flow-authoring-suite-plan.md`
Unit: `U1`
Covers: `R1-R7`, `R11-R14`, `KTD1-KTD6`

The consolidated authoring lane contains Agent tests only. This task supplies the shared Flow authoring fixtures, source ledger, fixed baseline manifest record, and core cross-form proof needed by the remaining slices.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: None.
- Unblocks: `jido-nnq.2` and `jido-nnq.3` by supplying shared fixtures, Catalog data, and the source disposition ledger.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: current `main` at task start.
- Combine: Land this task before U2 or U3 starts. Include the plan file in this task's commit.

## Source inventory

- Three source tests: `greeting_test.exs`, `adversarial_test.exs`, and `boundaries_test.exs` — ported and adapted.
- Nine assets under source `test/authoring/support/**` — ported and adapted.
- One source `test/authoring/README.md` — adapted to the Flow authoring README and expanded into the 22-asset disposition ledger.
- One source `guides_test.exs` — recorded as superseded by current guide and registered-example evidence.

## API and behavior map

- `Jido.Authoring.Registry` -> `Jido.Catalog`. Evidence: `test/support/fixtures/codec/registry.ex`.
- Stored Flow version 1 -> current stored Flow version 2. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/model_refactor_test.exs`.
- `Zoi.*` -> `Jido.Joi.*`. Evidence: current Flow and Action tests.
- Old Action and Flow errors -> current `Jido.Error` and codec diagnostics. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/**`.
- Old builders and codecs -> `JidoActionTest.FlowBuilder`, `FlowComponent`, and `FlowCodec`. Evidence: `test/support/flow_component.ex` and `test/support/generated_flow_codec.ex`.

## Files

- Read: fixed source `test/authoring/**`, `test/support/flow_component.ex`, `test/support/generated_flow_codec.ex`, `test/support/authoring_compiler.ex`, `test/support/fixtures/codec/registry.ex`
- Change: `test/quality/source_manifest.yml`
- Add: `docs/plans/2026-11-04-1255-test-flow-authoring-suite-plan.md`, `test/authoring/flows/README.md`, `test/authoring/flows/{greeting,adversarial,boundaries}_test.exs`, `test/authoring/support/flows/**`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `refs/**`, public runtime behavior, Mix aliases
- Expected shared changes: `test/quality/source_manifest.yml` and the plan file

## Instructions

1. Add the README ledger for all 22 fixed source assets and name the current evidence that supersedes the guide runner.
2. Adapt all nine support assets to current public test helpers and Catalog identifiers.
3. Port greeting, adversarial, and boundary scenarios across DSL, Map, direct, and stored version 2 forms.
4. Add the fixed baseline authoring record to the quality source manifest.
5. Tag every test module `:authoring` and serialize dynamic or message-order cases.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The README accounts for 12 source tests, nine support assets, and one README.
- [ ] The three target tests preserve current cross-form results and rejection behavior.
- [ ] Inspection, validation, decoding, and compilation do not run probe Action work.
- [ ] The quality source manifest records commit `177e7a4ce4342a9a6b7bc668f540dafbd7169d54` and the target authoring tree.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test.authoring test/authoring/flows/greeting_test.exs test/authoring/flows/adversarial_test.exs test/authoring/flows/boundaries_test.exs --warnings-as-errors` — exits with status 0.
- `mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs --seed 0` — exits with status 0.
- `mix format --check-formatted` and `git diff --check` — exit with status 0.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source disposition records, verification results, deviations from the plan, deferred assets, linked follow-up tickets, and remaining blockers.
A product failure must include the exact command, expected result, actual result, and a separate follow-up ticket before this task can close.

comments.text: Completed in c6fa3eb and landed on main as 9e5ee86. Added the implementation-ready plan, Flow authoring README with all 22 source dispositions, three adapted core parity tests, all nine support assets, and fixed-baseline source-manifest records. Verification passed: 18 focused authoring tests, 6 source-manifest tests, mix format --check-formatted, git diff --check, authoring tag scan, exact 22-row ledger, and no lib/** or refs/** changes. guides_test.exs is superseded by the named Spark and registered example evidence. No product correction or deferred asset.

title: Port core Flow authoring parity
